sentences.text:
---- Respondent
15.03.2024
Mr. Neeraj Kumar Mehta, Counsel for the Appellant.
Mrs. Prabha Sharma, Panel Lawyer for the State/Respondent.

Heard on I.A. No. 02/2023, an application filed under Section 389 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, seeking suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
The victim of this case is appeared through video conferencing from the DLSA, Sarguja.
On being asked, she has not opposed the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail submitted by the appellant.

By virtue of the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 17.11.2022, passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court (POCSO Act), Ambikapur, district - Surguja (C.G.) in Special POCSO Case No. 61/2017, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
 Conviction Sentences Under Section 363 of IPC 03 years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- in default of payment, rigorous imprisonment of 02 months.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in connection with the alleged crime.
It is contended further that the appellant was on bail during the course of trial and is languishing in jail since 17.11.2022.
Since the appeal will take some considerable time for its conclusion, therefore, the jail sentence as awarded by the Trial Court be kept in abeyance, till the disposal of this appeal.
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the Respondent/State has opposed the said application.
Having considered the aforesaid contention of the parties, considering the nature of incident and act committed by the appellant.
I am, therefore, inclined to allow this application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail, without further commenting anything on the merits of this case.

Accordingly, I.A. No. 02/2023 is allowed and it is directed that the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.25,000/- along with two surety of Rs. 10,000/- each in like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry on 08.04.2024.

He shall thereafter appear before the Trial Court on a date be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court till the disposal of this appeal.
In view of above, I.A. No. 02/2023, stands disposed of.
List this case thereafter.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Arvind Kumar Verma)
